loop1.prompt: Critique the current application state against industry standards, competitors, UX conventions, and commercial viability. Record every gap as an improvement finding with severity, area, evidence, and acceptance criteria. Do not close findings without verification.

loop2.prompt: Explore the application end-to-end using browser and automation tools. For each feature, identify real usage bugs. Record steps to reproduce, expected behavior, actual behavior, and severity. Do not close findings without verification.

loop3.prompt: Run the existing regression suite and previously verified workflows. Detect regressions caused by recent fixes. Record failing cases with steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, and source. If behavior intentionally changed, update the case instead of closing it.

invariants: Security: no hard-coded secrets, no exposed credentials
Error handling: no silent swallowed exceptions
Persistence: validated inputs, transactions where appropriate
External services: timeouts, retries, and fallbacks handled
